messages:
alex: alert-agent failed to page oncall for svc-search, customers seeing intermittent 504s starting ~07:14 UTC. manual escalation recommended.
maria: I'm oncall — paging now via SMS to oncall rotation (sam).
sam: ack'd SMS — on it. what's the scope?
ops-bot: alert recorded -> error=header_parse_error, detail=missing X-Route header. sample log:
```
ERR enqueue: header_parse_error: missing route
{"trace":"abc123","svc":"svc-search","attempts":1}
```
alex: about ~18 reqs/min failing for search endpoints, several enterprise customers reported timeouts. degradation but not full outage.
jamie: checking deploy history — there was a deploy at 07:05 touching alert-agent header parsing. looks suspect.
maria: runbook step 3: toggle fallback routing to bypass strict header requirement. can we flip it?
jamie: running toggles now:
```
curl -XPOST https://control/api/v1/flags/alert-agent \
  -d '{\"fallback_route\":true}'
```
ops-bot: flag set -> fallback_route=true. alert-agent requeued 42 pending pages.
alert-agent-bot: automated: reenqueue success=42, routed via fallback-route.
sam: pages are arriving, manual pages going through. API latency still elevated but trending down. any customer comms?
alex: sending a short outreach: "We're investigating delayed paging caused by internal routing validation. Mitigation in progress; will update in 30m."
maria: quick root cause: parser now rejects missing X-Route. either revert or patch to accept legacy X-Service header.
jamie: prepping a hotfix to tolerate empty X-Route and fallback to X-Service. pushing canary (10%) to start.
sam: start canary -> 10% nodes, monitor oncall pipeline and search latency.
ops-bot: canary deployed -> id=canary-7345, started.
alex: 6m after canary, latency down ~60%, paging stable. recommend ramp to 100%.
maria: creating incident ticket and postmortem stub. owners: jamie (fix + tests), alex (customer comms), sam (monitoring + rollback plan).
jamie: will include code diff, deploy timeline, and add unit/integration tests for header fallback.
alex: thanks team — nice quick mitigation. we'll do a full retro in #postmortems tomorrow. :thumbsup:
